description: Pro: save the rules track_sessions applies to a fleet: idle_minutes threshold, max_lifetime_minutes, default rates_per_hour by provider, and alert_webhook. Free returns a preview of the rules and saves nothing (pass the same values on each track_sessions call instead).

fleet.description: A stable name for this group of sandboxes, e.g. "my-agent". State and rules are kept per fleet.
